bug_semantics: An authenticated or otherwise protocol-reachable Kyuubi client can supply a local-file URI in Spark path-bearing session/batch configuration. When kyuubi.session.local.dir.allow.list is nonempty, the server accepted the URI whenever the unnormalized uri.getPath string began with an allowed directory. An absolute path such as /allowed/../outside/secret therefore passes the textual startsWith check, but the downstream filesystem/Spark consumer resolves .. and uses a local file outside the allow list. This bypass exposes server-local files to frontend clients.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable textual-prefix authorization check was first written in source commit 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b, the first member of PR #2991. Apache merged that ten-commit PR as squash b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77. Later source commits moved/refactored the check, but did not create the missing-normalization flaw.
ai_marker: No BIC commit-object AI signal. GitHub's Git-commit object for 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b has human author and committer Fei Wang <fwang12@ebay.com> and the complete message is exactly "save"; it has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Assisted-by, bot identity, or other AI trailer/marker.
evidence: Apache's first-party advisory at https://lists.apache.org/thread/xp460bwbyzdhho34ljd4nchyt2fmhodl names the mechanism as missing path normalization, says any frontend-protocol client can bypass kyuubi.session.local.dir.allow.list and use unlisted local files, marks 1.6.0 through 1.10.2 affected, and recommends 1.10.3 or later.

In the assigned clone, `git log --all -S'localDirAllowList.exists(uri.getPath.startsWith(_))' -- kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/engine/KyuubiApplicationManager.scala kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/session/KyuubiSessionManager.scala` returns introduction at squash b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77 and removals in direct fix 6d844ea02ef810543dfaf169ac7a49a54c0a846b and branch cherry-pick da728ba212f7c413ccf0894d23eebec96253417e.

`git log master -L 160,170:kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/engine/KyuubiApplicationManager.scala` shows b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77 adding `localDirAllowList.exists(uri.getPath.startsWith(_))`, c922ae28ab39898b3deedd6cfaded70140855724 only refactoring/expanding its use, and 6d844ea02ef810543dfaf169ac7a49a54c0a846b replacing it with `Paths.get(uri.getPath).normalize.startsWith(_)`.

`git show --format=fuller b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77` identifies a squash of PR #2991 and lists its ten abbreviated source commits. https://api.github.com/repos/apache/kyuubi/pulls/2991/commits resolves all ten full SHAs in parent order; the first is 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b.

https://api.github.com/repos/apache/kyuubi/commits/4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b shows that first source member adding SESSION_LOCAL_DIR_ALLOW_LIST, routing client-controlled Spark path configs into the gate, and adding `if (!localDirAllowList.exists(uri.getPath.startsWith(_)))`; its sole parent is 163e0f8232959b3fd365785f5a5312d2457bd290.

Direct parent verification: `git show 163e0f8232959b3fd365785f5a5312d2457bd290:kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/session/KyuubiSessionManager.scala` contains neither localDirAllowList nor checkSessionAccessPathURI nor the vulnerable startsWith authorization. The 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b patch creates all of them, so the immediate parent lacks the flaw.

`git tag --contains b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77 | sort -V` begins at v1.6.0-incubating (and its RCs), matching the configuration's `.version("1.6.0")`/generated settings entry and the advisory's first affected version.

`git show 6d844ea02ef810543dfaf169ac7a49a54c0a846b` shows the direct upstream fix: normalize uri.getPath before startsWith and add a regression for `/apache/kyuubi/../a.jar`. `git show da728ba212f7c413ccf0894d23eebec96253417e` has the same patch and explicitly says it was cherry-picked from 6d844ea02ef810543dfaf169ac7a49a54c0a846b.

`git tag --contains 6d844ea02ef810543dfaf169ac7a49a54c0a846b | sort -V` starts at v1.11.0, while `git tag --contains da728ba212f7c413ccf0894d23eebec96253417e | sort -V` returns v1.10.3 and v1.10.3-rc0. `git show v1.10.2:kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/engine/KyuubiApplicationManager.scala` has the raw-string startsWith check; the same path at v1.10.3 has `Paths.get(uri.getPath).normalize.startsWith(_)`.

BIC-only marker verification is reproducible at https://api.github.com/repos/apache/kyuubi/git/commits/4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b: author and committer are Fei Wang, and the full message is `save`, with no trailers or bot/AI identity. Later commits, including any later AI-assisted hardening, were excluded from the verdict as required.
reasoning: The vulnerability is specifically the decision to authorize a path before lexical normalization, not the later relocation of that code and not the merge squash. Mainline -S/-L history points to squash b585fb4257995d5dd8905c0a25e62a13a1264b77; decomposing its publicly retained PR chain shows the faulty startsWith gate already present in its first member 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b, while that member's direct parent has no gate. Therefore 4f2faa6a22541ef850f5b049149e08ab6fd4c49b is the smallest real BIC. The patch first shipped in 1.6.0. Direct fix 6d844ea02ef810543dfaf169ac7a49a54c0a846b normalizes the path, and its da728ba212f7c413ccf0894d23eebec96253417e cherry-pick is the closing 1.10.3 release-boundary fix. The BIC commit object is a human-authored 2022 commit with no AI marker, so the only supported verdict is NOT_AI.
